# Spring Boot mechanics

Boot 4.1 facts, checked 2026-08-21; the repository's build file wins, and Boot 4 split several
starters and test slices into per-module artifacts.

The universal backend rules live in `../SKILL.md`. On any conflict, SKILL.md wins.

## Shape of the app

- **Package by feature**, each top-level package a feature with its own internal layers. Top-level
  `controllers/`, `services/`, or `repositories/` is the package-by-layer anti-pattern; the Java row
  of `stack-profile`'s "Toolchain by language" table requires package-by-feature.
- **`@ConfigurationProperties` + `@Validated`**: binding runs `jakarta.validation` constraints
  **before** `@PostConstruct`, so a bad value is a startup failure naming the property, rejected
  value, and origin. Without `@Validated` the constraints are silently ignored.
- **On PCF, `java-cfenv-boot`** parses `VCAP_SERVICES` into Spring properties at environment
  post-processing time, activating only when Cloud Foundry is detected, so the same jar runs locally.
- **Flyway needs `spring-boot-starter-flyway` plus the engine module** (`flyway-database-postgresql`);
  the starter alone covers only embedded databases. Migrations run at startup; leave
  `spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto` at `none`. Live migration mechanics belong to
  `database-reliability`.
- **Graceful shutdown is on by default in Boot 4**; in-flight requests drain for
  `spring.lifecycle.timeout-per-shutdown-phase`. Raise the platform's stop grace period to match, or
  the drain is SIGKILLed mid-request.

## Request and response contracts

- **Records are the DTOs**, one per direction per resource; a controller returns the response record,
  never the entity. **`@Valid` on every `@RequestBody`.**
- **One `@RestControllerAdvice` extending `ResponseEntityExceptionHandler`** maps domain exceptions to
  `ProblemDetail`, with `spring.mvc.problemdetails.enabled=true` so the framework's own exceptions
  render as problem+json too.
- **Validation failures are `422`, not `400`** — the framework default is `400`, so the override
  passes `HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT` explicitly (older Framework versions spell it
  `UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY`).
- **`@PreAuthorize` is silently ignored unless method security is activated**: add
  `@EnableMethodSecurity` to a `@Configuration` class, and put method security on the service so a
  second caller of that service gets the same check.

## Service layer and runtime

- **Set `spring.jpa.open-in-view=false` on day one**, or a connection is held for the whole request
  and a `LazyInitializationException` appears only once you turn it off in production.
- **`spring.threads.virtual.enabled=true` on Java 21+** is this stack's answer to blocking I/O — not
  a reactive rewrite.

## Operability

- **Actuator probes**: `/actuator/health/liveness` and `/readiness` are separate health groups. On
  **Boot 3** they are enabled by default only in Kubernetes, so on PCF set
  `management.endpoint.health.probes.enabled=true` or the platform polls a 404 and marks every new
  instance unhealthy; **Boot 4** defaults the property on. Set it explicitly on every major so an
  upgrade cannot change it. If management runs on its own port, set
  `management.endpoint.health.probes.add-additional-paths=true`. Point the platform restart check at
  **liveness, never readiness** — readiness there turns a dependency outage into a restart storm.

## Testing

- **Testcontainers wired by `@ServiceConnection`** on the container field, with the
  `spring-boot-testcontainers` test dependency; a `GenericContainer` needs
  `@ServiceConnection(name = "...")` because Boot cannot infer the service from an untyped container.
- **Slices per module in Boot 4** (`spring-boot-webmvc-test` and friends). Slices skip
  `@Configuration` classes, so a custom `WebMvcConfigurer` needs an explicit `@Import`.
- **WireMock for upstream failure paths** — the timeout fires, the retry backs off, the breaker opens.
